rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Quiet residential kerb on Dell Road, homes 12-23 m away on this side.

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings 12-13 m from the kerb; homes all round within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a narrow grass verge; one car parked nearby, room for a van is tight.
drivers.convention: Few parked cars, no campers; signs only restrict 9am-5pm weekdays, not overnight.

flags: Houses 6 m away at 29 m along, so avoid further up
Signs: no parking Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, no stopping at the corner
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky over the road, with tree shade from the south side in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge is wide enough

best_section.where: North kerb of Dell Road, St Lucia, from the Picardy Street corner
